name: landing-page-copy
description: Landing page copywriting strategy — conversion copy frameworks, hero headline patterns, value proposition formulas, CTA copy, social proof placement, objection handling in copy, and A/B testing copy at scale. Based on Joanna Wiebe (Copyhackers), Oli Gardner (Unbounce), CXL (Peep Laja), and Harry Dry (Marketing Examples). Use when writing or optimizing landing page copy, designing hero sections, crafting CTAs, or running copy A/B tests. Triggers on: "landing page copy", "hero copy", "CTA copywriting", "conversion copy", "sales page copy".
